Implementation status

Source: IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md

The R package is version 0.3.0. This file supersedes the original assessment’s statements that no implementation exists.

Current qualification (0.3.0)

  • Qualified against outputs the original lab computed in MATLAB: 3,017 drawings with geometry and junctions, 2,757 with per-pixel medial-axis scores, and the complete Forest_DBW MAT. Pinned source under Octave reproduces the stored fields (no version drift). See PARITY.
  • Published-compatible options reproduce MATLAB: all segment geometry within 1e-9; 395,125/395,134 junctions exactly; Forest distance map, flux and skeleton exactly; 99.1–99.4% of stored per-pixel symmetry scores within 1e-4, with the residual traced to MLV’s single-precision arithmetic.
  • Defaults use alternative definitions for 14 newly documented differences from MLV (MLV-M018–M031) and are tested for invariance to contour/branch direction and numbering and to lattice symmetries. Thirteen R-port revisions were made (MLV-R005–R017), four of them by an independent review.
  • The installed suite passes locally (macOS arm64, R 4.5.1); hosted CI covers macOS, Windows and Ubuntu (R-devel, release, oldrel-1).
  • 77 retained upstream MATLAB files have no explicit license grant and are not in the public repository (licensing audit).
  • Not qualified: actual MATLAB execution (stored outputs are the reference), photograph-to-drawing extraction, and MATLAB rasterization ties on non-integer endpoints.

The sections below record the 0.1.1 port qualification and remain the basis for parity claims.

Implemented

  • Drawing validation and stable contour IDs; subpixel geometry; explicit cleaning.
  • Orientation, length, curvature, axial mean orientation and typed statistics.
  • Exact sweep-filtered junctions, consistent angles and transitive merging.
  • Conservative whole-contour splitting, model/histogram scores, rotation, shifting, stable circle clipping, junction segmentation and arc-length regions.
  • Deterministic rasterization, exact EDT/nearest indices, compiled AOF, attributed Octave-image Pratt morphology, graph tracing, branch scores and tangent mapping.
  • Valid-zero score masks, local score rendering, feature densities and batch tables.
  • SVG paths/arcs/transforms/aspect ratios, v5 MAT structures, PNG/JPEG adapters, and explicit RGB extraction providers.
  • All 62 original top-level functions mapped in FUNCTION_MAP. Bundled SAM/legacy-forest models are not part of the package.

Executed numerical evidence

  • The installed suite has 583 passing assertions, including independent geometry, exhaustive EDT/nearest-search, metamorphic and public workflow tests.
  • Eighteen synthetic cases execute pinned Octave/Python references across contours, histogram bins, rotations, MAT masks, AOF radii and branch shapes. All 289 comparisons are retained: 226 match and 63 have documented explanations.
  • A retained forest drawing (562 contours / 2,072 segments after removing one zero-length contour) matches reference geometry and histograms within explicit tolerances. Python length histograms require a labeled shape adaptation.
  • Six MAT distance maps agree. Default skeletons differ on four masks at exact nearest-boundary ties. Keeping R distances and substituting Octave labels makes all six skeletons identical, with AOF differences below 1.5e-14.
  • Analytical boundary and distance tests led to two R-port revisions: odd-bin axial histogram boundaries and isolated-pixel signed distances.
  • Exact old-output witnesses cover grouped statistics and tangent samples; filtered mapping agrees with exhaustive nearest-sample search.

See PARITY for the stage matrix, plots, tolerances, adapters, natural drawing and the reference-implementation differences it reproduces. Actual MATLAB was not executed.

Qualification (0.1.1)

Source d83ed952fdc9f639b98e849b0d8697259894de46 passes R CMD check –as-cran –no-manual with 0 errors, 0 warnings and one informational New submission NOTE. R and instrumented C++ coverage is 92.8989% (previously 92.6117%). Examples and vignette rebuilds pass.

Paired local measurements improve the 1,000-contour feature table from 1.609 s to 30.875 ms (52.1x), the long statistics table 45.6x, and full MAT on four 256x256 elliptical rings 1.91-1.92x. All five representative old/new workload outputs are identical. Forest histograms take 6.656 ms, versus 619 ms in R 0.1.0, 83.292 ms in Octave and 7.471 ms in shape-adapted Python. These are local workload-specific observations, not MATLAB JIT or complete image-pipeline claims.

See qualification, performance and receipts in docs/evidence/parity-perf. The local installable archive is mlvtoolbox_0.1.1.tar.gz; it is ignored by Git and can be rebuilt with tools/bounded_check.py. The 0.1.0 archive and historical evidence are preserved.

Prepared CI covers macOS, Windows and Linux. No CRAN/R-universe submission, site deployment or upstream issue submission has occurred.

The full Python image pipeline and actual MATLAB have not run. Natural-image scientific acceptance, peak RSS, parallel scaling, general SVG paint effects, MAT v7.3/HDF5 and bundled SAM extraction remain outside this qualification. Rasterization, graph tracing, EDT ties, taper smoothing and axial mean orientation have explicit method choices documented in DIFFERENCES.md.

Storage and provenance

Cleanup verified 159 source files and 39 retained data files, removed about 2.63 GiB of logical content, and preserved one local reference-data collection. See CLEANUP_RECEIPT.json, vendor/SOURCES.json and tools/restore_upstream.py.

The R implementation and attributed derived kernels are GPL-3.0-or-later. Original reference notices and mixed rights remain recorded; this local port does not assert dataset redistribution rights or blanket upstream relicensing.
